book.name: Luk
book.title: Ka꞉dle molo atlale yu Lukta ilimale Luk

content: Yesuta itiyamale dla atlanatili

Alila hale dla Yesu Yu so inoma sumalalo aya dla hetame opa watle God yu imhallati aiyalma aya dokopala so mate epo aiyalma imalalo so mate epame Yu so dokopala so mateta puame Yesu watle epo atlaiyo,
“Wa꞉ apa itiyamale tle koko iye hamsela꞉ma꞉? Anta wa꞉ watle itiyamale iye hamiwa?” diyo.
Epalati Yesuta asiyama yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ mape wua꞉ watle atlanatili yu hatlo atlowama. Epapedeme wua꞉ta na꞉ atlaiya,
Anta Yon watle itiyamale hamiwa, opa yú dla ka꞉ka꞉timsela꞉lepo depame? Godta itiyamale hamiwa o oplamita itiyamale hamiwa?” diyo.

Epalati yia꞉ta yu i dalepame yiskamu yia꞉ dulu dla esemyemama epo atlamyaiyo, “Di adipo atlepa꞉? Di Yonta itiyamaleye God tle puwa dlepiye, ma asiyama Yesuta di watle epo atellepe, ‘Ame wua꞉ adipalati Yon yu dla pomikadepe dlalo wekuwa?’ dlepe.

Epame di ma ya꞉ta itiyamaleye oplami tle puwa dlepiye, ma asiyama opata dia꞉ dla siyalasiyalademama dia꞉ye ewalata kelemelepe. Adipalati, opa hapulomata Yonye God yu molo atlalo oplami ikadepe demdepo,” demyaiyo.
Epammama yia꞉ta asiyama Yesu watle epo atlaiyo, “Di podimalamana, Yonta itiyamale halë sitaliye,” diyo.
Epalati asiyama Yesuta yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ ma asiyama wua꞉ watle na꞉ta itiyamale hamsela꞉ iye po-atlowa,” diyo.
Batalipo omha꞉ha꞉lalo so kokoye wayu mate atlale

Epame Yesu ma wayu hale i mate opa watle epo atlaiyo, “Alila haleta oplami hale ya꞉ osalo dulu dla gla꞉pi dlomoko emaiyo. Ya꞉ dlomoko empame opa opi watle omha꞉ha꞉iye depame ma mo hale pateka꞉mu dla halla taiyo.

Ya꞉ edla tame hallati dlomokota milipame namolowe alilata mo-puaiyo. Epalati ya꞉tapo ya꞉ oko oplami hale watle ya꞉ osalo dla tame dlomokoye halopo puane diyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ edla tame woyamalati osalo omha꞉ha꞉lalo sota ya꞉ye hopolopame alisisi dimi ma ilame tane diyo.
Epela natipame yotapo ma oplami haleye tane diyo. Amasiyama omha꞉ha꞉lalo sota oplami i mape hopolemama ya꞉ watle wota꞉le hamipame alisisi dimi ma ilame tane diyo.
Epalati yota mamisika꞉ ya꞉ oko oplami haleye ma tane diyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ mape omha꞉ha꞉lalo sotapo hopolepame alikili a꞉ma dodolomaiyo.

Epela natipame yotapo ya꞉skamu epo malamaiyo, ‘Na꞉ apa koko hapa꞉? Na꞉ matle na꞉ dupa ellalo maseyemala tlo tane dlowepo. Pona꞉malamana, epelepiye, yia꞉ta ya꞉ dla heodepame ya꞉ yu dla salladlowe sepena,’ diyo.

Amasiyama osalo omha꞉ha꞉lalo sotapo osalo ya꞉ a yamita pulati natipame yiskamu yia꞉ dulu dla epo atlamyaiyo, ‘Maseyemala itapo osalo ya꞉ a elo dla hallala. Epedeme ya꞉ye yumpame osalo iye dita halowa,’ demyaiyo.

Epammama yia꞉ maseyemala eye osalo alikili dla hamame tame yumiyo.” Yesutapo yu iye atlepo gudepame halemama ya꞉ yu dalempopa꞉lalo so watle epo atlaiyo, “Osalo yota ma osalo omha꞉ha꞉lalo so dla apa koko hapa꞉?
Ya꞉ puame yia꞉ye potipame ma opa amko hohopo ya꞉ osaloye omha꞉ha꞉iya dlepe,” diyo. Epalati opa hapuloma Yesu yu dalempopa꞉letapo epo atlamyaiyo, “Koko ipapeleta woyamoloweye poka꞉dena,” demyaiyo.
Amasiyama Yesuta yia꞉ dla omhalemama epo atlaiyo, “Ame adipalati God yu bukata ipo atlema꞉?

content.text: alumiti hamastaletapo ma aya duka dla molopa kestale some halapo.’

content: Epedeme oplami antapo alumiti edla kustamtame teyulupiye, ya꞉ye susupulastepo hamastlepe. Epame alumiti etapo oplami haleye goludlepiye, oplami eye totola꞉timtame ellepe,” diyo.

Epalati aiyalma imalalo so mate epo aiyalma aya dokopala so mateta, “Yesuye wayu i mate di kokoye atlemhalema,” depame ya꞉ye medla hamolowedeme api totamaiyo. Amasiyama yia꞉ Yesu hamoloweye opa alumale pato natipame wowota꞉iyo.
Sisa dla ta꞉kis mani hapilowe koko

Epapele dulu dla aiyalma imalalo so mate epo aiyalma aya dokopala so mateta Yesu yumuluwe api totamama opa opi taiya demama epo atlaiyo, “Wua꞉ tame Yesu mate namkale depo siyamama ya꞉ watle atlanatili yu atlamsiyamaiye. Epapele dulu dla Yesuta asiyama yu batalimale adipapele atlepiye, dita ya꞉ye hampame gamani dokopala oplami dla homellowepo,” diyo.

Yia꞉ epalati tame Yesu watle yu o-opalimama epo atlaiyo, “Imalalo oplami, dimalamana, wa꞉ta imale dulu dla wa꞉ isikimi ka꞉dle koko siyapo tlo imdepo. Epame wa꞉ opaye isikimi kapala di hema potlamasemde. Amasiyama wa꞉ ikadepe God koko tlo imsela꞉mde.
Epedeme wa꞉ di atlane, di ka꞉deta꞉, Loum dokopala oplami Sisa watle ta꞉kis mani halopiliweye?” diyo.
Amasiyama Yesuye yia꞉ta yu o-opalli mate ya꞉ hamolowedeme apele malanatipame yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo,
“Na꞉ watle elo mani hale nati-iya,” diyo. Epame ya꞉ta mani hapo halemama epo atlaiyo, “Mani hema ana mila꞉pi mate epo ana hi mate hutiyema꞉?” diyo.

Epalati asiyama yia꞉ta epo atlaiyo, “Sisa mila꞉pi mate epo ya꞉ hi mateta hutiyema,” diyo. Epapalati Yesuta halemama yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wua꞉ epapedeme Sisa teteye Sisa watle halopiya, epame God teteye God watle halopiya,” diyo.
Epalati yia꞉ta Yesuta asiyama yu ka꞉depo hamilati dalepame sikemte yiyelemama yu opi po-atlamaiyo. Epammama yia꞉tapo Yesuta opa mila꞉pi tle batalipo atlati ya꞉ye hamoloweye api ponatiyo.
Palli tle ma silliwe dla Yesu watle atlanatili
Epame Sa꞉dusi so opa opita Yesu hala dla pumulaiyo. Opa iwolota atlemama, “palli sota ma posilliwa,” demdepo. Epeleye yia꞉tapo puame Yesu watle epo atlaiyo,

“Imalalo oplami, Mosesta di watle molo atlale yuye ipo ilipo hamiwa, ‘Oplamitapo a꞉ya hapo yimlala pohatitimalalo halepo polopiye, ma oplami e ya꞉ eita sepeyama eye hapo ya꞉ bapa elo dla ha꞉ha꞉lowe yimlala hatitimelepe’ duwapo.
Epapedeme oplami haletapo akimlala 7 hatitimaiyo. Epame yia꞉ bapa tatle a꞉ya haiyo. Epo yimlala pohatitimalalo halemama powaiyo.
Epalati ma medla hallalota ya꞉ bapa ya꞉llu sepeyama me-eye haiyo. Ya꞉ mape yimlala pohatitimalalo powaiyo.
Epo ma medla hallalota sepeyama hatlo me-eye haiyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ mape yimlala pohatitimalalo powaiyo. Epamtamama akimlala 7 hapuloma ewolotapo yimlala pohatitimalalo pataiyo.
Epo a꞉ya sepeyama eta mosukulu powaiyo.
Epedeme palli tle silliwe oloma edla a꞉ya eye ikadepe ana ya꞉llu depa꞉? Adipalati, yia꞉ta 7ta a꞉ya hatlo metlo halompuwapo,” diyo.
Amasiyama Yesuta asiyama yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wata ha꞉ha꞉ oloma hema opatapo wola꞉ haloma epo wola꞉tapo opa haloma demha꞉ha꞉po.
Amasiyama Godta sesa꞉le sotapo palli tle sillipo ha꞉ha꞉lepiye, yia꞉ matle opa mate epo wola꞉ mate pohalomha꞉ha꞉lowa.
Adipalati, yia꞉ye God ya꞉ banakaka so some ha꞉ha꞉mama matle popalliwa. Epame yia꞉ye God ya꞉ akimlala depo ha꞉ha꞉lepe. Adipalati, Godtapo yia꞉ye palli tle me-elepo ta꞉ta꞉duwapo.

Epedeme Mosesta mo-powataliya ya꞉ buka dla opata palli tle silliwe kokoye me-imuwapo. Adipalati, ya꞉tapo dali upaye dlapata hamdemhallati natili kokoye ilipo hamimama epo atluwapo, ‘Lodye A꞉iblaham mate epo Aisek mate epo Yokob mate yia꞉ Godpo,’ duwapo.
Epapedeme God iye popalli so yia꞉ God. Hao, pasakalo ha꞉ha꞉lalo so yia꞉ Godpo. Adipalati, Godta natili dulu dla opa hapulomaye pasakalo ha꞉ha꞉po.”
Epalati aiyalma imalalo so opitapo Yesuta yu atlamale dalepame ka꞉pi demyaiyo.
Epalati dulu edla ma oplami haleta Yesu watle atlanatili yu hale atloweye wowota꞉iyo.
Kelisoye ana yamita꞉?
Epame Yesuta ma opa watle atlanatili yu i atlaiyo, “Adipalati opa opita Kelisoye Deibidi yami demdi?
Amasiyama Deibidi meyelo Sam buka dulu dla ipo atluwapo,

content.text: Wa꞉ na꞉ dowala tiyama dla polane.
Epalati na꞉tapo wa꞉ watle opahale demha꞉ha꞉ soye wa꞉ hete sitali isili dla hatitimolowepo,’ duwapo.

content: Epedeme Deibidita Kelisoye ya꞉ Lod duwapo. Ame adipammama Kelisoye Deibidi yami depa꞉?” diyo.
Yesuta aiyalma imalalo so koko atlale
Opa hapulomata ala me-dalemha꞉ha꞉lati Yesuta ya꞉ alotle tlalo so watle epo atlaiyo,

“Ka꞉e! Wua꞉ aiyalma imalalo so opa woloma natiye. Yia꞉ tluka ka꞉ka꞉dle tlo didiyepo siyamdepo. Epo yia꞉ solotamde, opata yia꞉ natipame yia꞉ watle heodepo siyele yu atlamelepo depame. Yia꞉ epame dita inoma sumalalo aya dla epo daya pato dele dla itapu ikadepe dla popa꞉lowe tlo solotamdepo.

Yia꞉ epo isikimi elemale tle sepeyamataloye dodolomsalepame yia꞉ ayaye kokolahamdepo. Epame yia꞉ opa hapuloma inoma dali tle inoma sumale yu seselemalli atlamdepo. Epedeme yia꞉ asiyama wotiyalle pato halepe.”
